newsitem.title: USA: Senate to begin hearings on campaign funds scandal.
newsitem.headline: Senate to begin hearings on campaign funds scandal.

text.p: The Senate committee investigating campaign fund raising will begin public hearings in the week of July 8, committee Chairman Sen. Fred Thompson said Thursday.

"We will begin hearings the week of July 8 and they will be good hearings," the Tennessee Republican said in remarks prepared for delivery to the Senate Governmental Affairs Committee. "We will begin to get answers to questions concerning whether or not the fundamental integrity of our government has been abused or compromised."
The committee is probing whether Asian business interests or the Chinese government tried to influence the 1996 presidential election by illegally donating funds to the Democratic Party.
The committee met to discuss Thompson's request to grant immunity from prosecution to 19 witnesses.
But the seven Democrats on the committee vowed to oppose him. They have the power to block him since Thompson needed the votes of at least two Democrats to proceed with his plan.
